spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact shipped surface — the PredefinedColorSpace enum as consumed by getContext('2d', {colorSpace}), OffscreenCanvas 2d settings, the ImageData constructor's ImageDataSettings, and getImageData settings — and treats only requested===readback as support, matching the WPT getContextAttributes set-and-get contract this feature cites.

interactive.rationale: A run button executes sixteen real probes and fills the matrix from live results; a free-text input probes any value (rec2100-linear suggested) across all four surfaces; the load-time banner is itself a real readback probe.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the four-values-by-four-surfaces matrix with readback per cell, which is exactly what the page renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Three outcome classes are distinguished per cell — reads-back-as-requested, created-but-reports-something-else (the ignored-member trap), and rejected-with-exception shown verbatim — so partial support (one linear space but not the other, as measured on flagged Chromium 141) renders as its own banner state.

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/5122501071994880, the HTML spec enum section, and the sibling enum-gate concept.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite (8 assertions) runs the same create-and-read-back probes for both new values on context, ImageData and OffscreenCanvas, plus a display-p3 baseline and an unknown-value-throws assertion, each anchored to the spec's real dom-predefinedcolorspace-* IDs.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: matrix run and custom probe clicked at 1280×2000 and 360×1600; matrix rendered 8 read-back cells (srgb, display-p3) and 8 verbatim TypeError cells (srgb-linear, display-p3-linear); zero console errors; desktop and mobile post-interaction screenshots read; the real success path for srgb-linear was additionally reproduced behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features on all four surfaces.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the baseline (srgb + display-p3 read back) separately from the new values, and emits matrix-<value>-unsupported-honestly-reported for the fallback branch instead of a fake pass; console output is one intentional summary line.

design_system.rationale: All colours are styles.css variables; buttons keep the dark-background/ivory-text pair with a visible focus ring; state colours (emerald/rose/amber) sit on near-white backgrounds; the matrix lives in an overflow-x scroller.

accessibility.rationale: Native button/input controls with labels, scope attributes on table headers, aria-live on the banner, summary and custom output, legend text mirrored by cell text (state words are not colour-only since each cell carries the readback/exception string), and focus-visible outlines.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×1600 DPR3 and 1280×2000: no horizontal page overflow (the wide matrix scrolls inside its own container), 44px-min buttons and input, and identical probe behaviour on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Re-run the matrix on a Chrome 155 build and refresh the measured notes
openQuestions.detail: All measured copy is from Chromium 141 (both new values TypeError unflagged; srgb-linear works behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features; display-p3-linear absent from that build's enum). When a 155+ binary is available to the harness, re-run to capture the shipped full-support state and confirm the banner's both-supported branch renders.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose dynamic results as text with live-region announcements and keep semantic table structure with named controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Matrix results are real table text (th scope row/col), the banner and summaries use aria-live=polite, and every control is a native labelled button/input.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless CDP run 2026-09-13: readouts announced via #summary/#custom-out textContent after each click

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form controls color picker sliders live region announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate a visible label with every input and expose state changes programmatically.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The custom-value input is wrapped in a label element; probe outcomes land in an output element with aria-live.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: DOM dump shows label[for=custom] wrapping and output#custom-out

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let wide data tables scroll in their own overflow container instead of widening the page; wrap button rows with flex-wrap.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The 5-column matrix sits in .scroller{overflow-x:auto}; button rows use flex-wrap; page scrollWidth equals viewport at 360px.

summary: Built alongside the feature (first demo wave). The matrix probes the exact enum contract on all four accepting surfaces with requested-vs-readback semantics, displays exceptions verbatim, and was verified honest on unflagged Chromium 141 (16 real outcomes: 8 readbacks, 8 TypeErrors) plus the real srgb-linear success path behind the experimental flag.
